name: Direct Reasoning
description: Uses the LLM's built-in knowledge to reason about code without invoking external tools.

name: Edge Case Reasoning
description: Systematically considers boundary values, empty inputs, type mismatches, and overflow conditions.

name: Test-Driven Analysis
description: Generates and runs tests to empirically verify hypotheses about code behaviour.

name: Root Cause Analysis
description: Traces observed failures back to their fundamental source rather than treating symptoms.

name: Patch Suggestion
description: Proposes minimal, correct code changes that fix the identified issue without introducing regressions.
